en: A black-and-white photograph of a cobblestone street lined with old European-style buildings. The architecture features ornate roofs and spires, including a building on the right with two pointed towers and a sign that reads 'Villa Carola.' The street is moderately busy, with several pedestrians and a horse-drawn carriage. The feeling is early 20th century, suggested by the fashion and absence of modern vehicles.
